GEN Collagen (68 followers)
We’re delighted to be back at Costco Watford this week.

Costco roadshows continue to be an important part of our retail growth strategy, allowing us to engage directly with members, gather valuable customer insights, and demonstrate the benefits of premium collagen supplementation in a live retail environment.

For emerging health and wellness brands, there’s no substitute for face-to-face interaction with customers. These events provide immediate feedback, drive trial, and help build lasting brand trust.

A big thank you to the Costco team for their continued support. We’re looking forward to another successful weekend and meeting members at Watford.

📍 Costco Watford
📅 Thursday – Sunday 11th to 14th June

If you’re attending, come and say hi to the GEN Collagen team Kim Harris, Shirley Chow
